policy.official_reference_use: A human-reviewed official link is usable within its recorded scope after checking publisher, source identity, language, displayed date/version or cutoff, relevant content, and visible limits. No local capture, conversion, hash, or replay is required for ordinary link use.
policy.local_artifact_acceptance: No local French statute copy is accepted by this register. Copy-specific checks apply only if a copy is later retained; they do not gate these official links.
policy.coverage: Usable official references do not by themselves establish adequate topic coverage or country completion.

fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.publisher: Direction de l’information légale et administrative (DILA), Légifrance
fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.version_or_cutoff: Légifrance page header displayed 'Version en vigueur au 24/08/2026' when checked on 2026-10-21; unpinned link follows the maintained section.
fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.scope: CESEDA legislative Book II, Articles L. 200-1 to L. 286-2, governing entry, residence, and removal of EU citizens and family members, with the assimilation specified in Article L. 200-3.
fr-ceseda-book-ii-legislative.reviewed_content: The page identifies the official code and Book II scope; Article L. 200-3 names EEA EFTA and Swiss nationals within the code’s conditions. The Book II section includes residence rules and Légifrance flags the 2022 partial annulment affecting L. 233-1 and L. 233-2.
limitations: French text only; this is not an English translation.
The displayed version cutoff was 24 August 2026; recheck the page header for later versions when using it for a date-sensitive question.
